name: Sunway Berhad
summary: Sunway Berhad, an investment holding company, operates in the real estate, construction, education, healthcare, retail, and hospitality sectors in Malaysia, Singapore, China, India, Australia, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and internationally. Its Property Development segment develops residential, industrial, and commercial properties. The company's Property Investment segment is involved in the management, operation, and letting of properties; operation of theme parks; rendering recreational club facilities; travel agent; management and operation of hotels; and investment in real estate investment fund.
